description: This file defines the ActivityDetailsReportController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages the preparation and rendering of activity details reports, initializing a Vue component and populating its properties based on request query parameters, such as date range, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion options.

classes.name: ActivityDetailsReportController
classes.description: Controller class for handling activity details report view logic, extending the abstract Vue controller to render components based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties derived from HTTP request query parameters, including date range, project, activity, and timesheet options, before rendering.
